completion_data.completion_summary: Resumed an interrupted dispatch: reconciled stale plan markers against already-committed phases 1-8 (verified via diff and directory-scoped grep, not re-done), then completed phase 9 (manifest.json + verify-deploy.sh gate 12 + redeploy, with a line_count drift fix) and phase 10 (full verification bar: 19-hit grep fully evidenced against six exclusion classes, founder+present dry-run smoke test, $CSLIB_STATE confirmed clean by direct read, lint fixture test 8/8, verify-deploy.sh 22/23 with gate 12 passing cleanly). One pre-existing, unrelated verify-deploy.sh gate-8 test-suite defect was discovered, evidenced as out-of-scope, and recorded as a follow-up rather than fixed or papered over.

memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh's shell test suites can carry a REPO_ROOT path-depth bug that only manifests on a repo cloned at a nesting depth different from what the script's fixed '../../../../..' chain assumes (e.g. '~/.config/nvim' adds 2 extra path segments versus a bare '~/project' layout). Before treating a verify-deploy.sh test-suite gate failure as caused by in-flight work, check whether the failing script computes REPO_ROOT via a fixed-count '..' chain from SCRIPT_DIR and whether that chain's assumed depth matches this repo's actual clone depth; a mismatch is a pre-existing, environment-specific defect, not a regression.

When resuming an /implement dispatch after an interruption mid-fan-out, do not trust a plan's phase-heading markers at face value: verify each claimed-stale phase against 'git log --oneline | grep "task N phase"' and re-run that phase's own directory-scoped grep/verification before either re-doing it or marking it COMPLETED. Concurrently-dispatched sub-agents from the interrupted run may still be finishing and committing in the background; re-check git status/log immediately before starting new phase work, not just once at the start.
